detail: Core handled 10.2 million transactions and £4.49bn premium in the last 12 months; Mobius 267,000 and £123m. Value per transaction is almost the same (about £440 vs £461).

mobius_source: Power BI: Mobius Transactions; broker labels incomplete, corrected from Mobius wiki
detail: Core: hundreds of brokers, Somerset Bridge about a fifth of volume. Mobius: about ten live customers; Power BI names only some, so labels were corrected from the Mobius wiki.
Mobius: 373 people used the screens in the last 3 months across ten live customers (LogRocket). No Core user counts were found in the sources reviewed.
Mobius: 3 in 4 page loads finish within 1.56s; quote pages 1.54s; client records 1.11s. Core is a desktop app with no timing data.
Core: about 10 system errors per 1,000 transactions, down about 70% since early 2025. Mobius: 18% of sessions hit a failed request, rising to 46% in MTA, 39% in payments and 38% in quotes.

core_source: Power BI: UI Aborts (capped, stale since June 2026)
mobius_source: LogRocket crash reporting not switched on
detail: Core keeps only the last 8 aborts per site, so 398 a year is a minimum, and the feed stopped in June 2026. Mobius crash reporting is not switched on, so 0% means nothing.
Mobius: 89% of quotes reach a summary, 80% of MTAs are confirmed, 62% of payment summaries become a sale. Core does not record the steps.
Mobius: 18% of sessions include a rage click and 26% a dead click; the View button is the top culprit, matching the navigation audit.
Core: 1.3 tickets per 1,000 transactions, 99% within SLA. Mobius: 3.5 per 1,000, 87% within SLA, and 40% of tickets are code defects.
Core support averages 4.8 out of 5 from 92 ratings. Only 1 Mobius ticket has a rating, so it cannot be compared.
No product satisfaction or usability score is collected for either product. A survey and benchmark study would fill this.

mobius_source: Automated WCAG 2.2 AA scan of 11 pages in a test tenant (November 2026)
detail: Every Mobius page scanned fails WCAG 2.2 AA. The quote form has 17 fields with no programmatic label, and error messages are not announced to screen readers. Most failures come from three shared sources: the page shell, the component library and the form renderer, so fixing those would clear most issues product-wide. Automated scanning finds about a third of issues, so this is a floor. Core has not been assessed.

mobius_source: Design target only (Mobius wiki architecture decision); Application Insights not accessible
detail: Mobius was designed for 99.98% availability, and a major customer asked for 99.99%, but uptime is not reported for either product. The tender answer was left blank.

mobius_source: Mobius wiki: 15-minute RPO, DR exercise done, no RTO
detail: Mobius databases can lose up to 15 minutes of data; a disaster recovery exercise was completed, but no recovery time is recorded. Nothing found for Core.
Mobius 2024 load tests: new business and renewal coped with 150 users; MTA failed at 100 in at least one run, against a 200-user requirement. Nothing found for Core.

mobius_source: Power BI: MEND (to Dec 2025); Mobius wiki: 2025 pen test
detail: Mobius 2025 penetration test found 6 issues (none critical), all still open. Scanning tool shows open vulnerabilities for both, but Core was scanned only once.
Core: 557 bugs, 7.1 days to close. Mobius: 2,596 bugs, 9.8 days, reflecting heavier development.

mobius_source: Power BI DORA report stale since Dec 2024
detail: Mobius deploys about 25 times a day and tracks delivery metrics, but the published report stopped in December 2024. Nothing found for Core.
Core renews 78% of policies; Mobius 82%, with the same cancellation rate.
About 15% of Core transactions go straight through to the insurer. Mobius is not in the same data model.
For hybrid and headless Mobius customers the API is the experience; the API strategy admits it is hard to integrate with today. Usage data exists but is not accessible.

mobius_source: Mobius wiki: written targets (not ratified), architecture decisions and principles
detail: Mobius has written targets (90% of screens within 2s, under 0.5% errors) but they were never ratified and are marked for replacement. None found for Core.
